card.desc: A plane passing high overhead. Scale, and somewhere else to be.
card.prompt: a distant passenger jet passing high overhead, low rumble rising and falling, exterior, open air
card.negative: music, speech, propeller, helicopter, crowd, indoor, reverb
card.note: Distant and low - ask for a jet close and you get a takeoff, which is a different scene entirely.
